environment.description: Service runs in private subnet (no IGW route) behind internal NLB (network load balancer) with TLS termination. NLB target group health check on /config. Upstream traffic arrives only through AWS PrivateLink endpoint (vpce-0f8c3a91d) configured in the shared-services VPC. The PrivateLink endpoint policy restricts access to principals matching condition aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-a1b2c3d4e5. Additionally, the NLB has a listener-level security policy (ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06) and the target group's source IP preservation is disabled, meaning X-Forwarded-For reflects only the VPC endpoint ENI addresses (172.31.64.0/20 range). The service's Security Group sg-0x9f1c only allows ingress from the NLB's ENI IPs in 172.31.64.0/20 on port 8080. No internet-routable path exists to the service; all access must traverse the PrivateLink endpoint which is governed by the endpoint policy restricting to organization members only.
